analysis.reason: RSI 37.3으로 과매도 구간 진입, 5일 저가 갱신 후 반등 시도 중. 그러나 MACD 히스토그램은 -4.5412로 악화되며 약세 수렴 중. ADX 29.4로 추세는 뚜렷하나 -DI가 +DI보다 우위에 있어 하락 압력 우세. 52주 저가 대비 22.6% 위치로 하방 경직성 확인되나, 5일 평균 거래량 대비 1.36배 거래량으로 반등 모멘텀 부족. 731.00 저항선 돌파 여부 확인 필요.
analysis.reasonEn: RSI at 37.3, entering oversold territory, attempting a bounce after updating the 5-day low. However, MACD histogram is worsening to -4.5412, indicating bearish convergence. ADX at 29.4 shows a clear trend, but -DI is dominant over +DI, suggesting downward pressure. At 22.6% from the 52-week low, some downside support is evident, but the 1.36x average 5-day volume suggests insufficient momentum for a sustained bounce. Confirmation needed above the 731.00 resistance.

analysis.narrativeEn:

· Current Price ($715.00) vs SMA5 ($729.59)/SMA20 ($796.18)/SMA50 ($883.58): Below short/mid-term trends, indicating a weak position.
· Significantly below SMA100 ($936.07)/SMA200 ($950.25): Long-term trend weakening.

[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI 39.2 → 37.3 (entering oversold): Downward momentum strengthening.
· MACD Histogram -2.8315 → -4.5412 (worsening): Bearish convergence continues.
· Bollinger Band current price position (near lower band $684.40): Approaching lower band, with band width at 28.08% indicating expanding volatility.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support ($617.11): Support based on the 52-week low.
· Swing Resistance ($731.00): First resistance level for short-term bounces.
· 5-day High/Low Pattern: Attempting a bounce after updating the 5-day low, but failing to exceed the 20-day high.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (1.36x): Increased volume on bounce attempts, adding some conviction to the move.
· Current Stage Diagnosis (Accumulation): RSI entering oversold and attempting a bounce after updating the 5-day low, but maintaining a wait-and-see approach due to MACD deterioration and weak ADX trend.
